title: Random List Picker
h1: Random List Picker — Draw Winners from a List
seoTitle: Random List Picker — Free Online Name Picker
description: Paste a list of names or items and randomly pick one or more winners. Perfect for giveaways, classrooms and raffles. Runs privately in your browser.
intro: Enter one item per line. Choose how many to pick and get a fair random selection instantly. Nothing is uploaded.
blurb: Randomly pick one or more items from a pasted list of names or options.
howItWorks: Paste your list with one name or item on each line.
Set how many unique items you want to draw.
Click Pick randomly to see the fair random selection.
examples: A classroom teacher picks one student to answer from the class list.
A giveaway host draws three winners from a list of entrants.
A team picks a random lunch option from a list of restaurants.

faq.a: Yes. It uses the browser's Math.random which provides a uniform distribution so every remaining item has an equal chance of being picked.
Yes. Empty lines are ignored and the same item is not picked more than once in a single draw.

faq.q: Is my list sent to a server?
faq.a: No. Everything happens locally in your browser. Your list never leaves your device.
